subject: Trial Playbook: Success Signals, Owners, and Buy/Roll Decision Timeline
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Tom Rivers <tom.r@medlyhealth.com>, Hannah Li <hannah.li@medlyhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call summary & proposed trial playbook

Hi Tom / Hannah — great to meet today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a clear trial playbook and decision rhythm.

Summary of discovery
- Primary goal: reduce clinician note-search time and triage latency across care teams (target: 30% reduction in average time-to-action).
- Data scope: outpatient notes + structured triage events (no PHI export).
- Integration constraints: SSO + SFTP for batch data.

Proposed POC (2-week pilot + 2-week extension if needed) — key pieces:
1) Success signals (primary + guardrails)
   - Primary metric: mean time-to-first-action reduced by >=25% on sampled workflows.
   - Quality gate: average precision@10 for reranking >= 0.78 on Red Team prompts.
   - Safety checks: zero high-severity hallucinations in spot-check audit (sampling definition below).
2) Ownership
   - Redwood: runtime config, model tuning, eval harness, and 24/7 on-call for infra. (Owner: me)
   - Medly: dataset access, local SME for annotations, procurement contact for contractual approvals. (Owner: Tom)
3) Access & infra
   - We'll provision a dedicated Redwood-optimized 7B q4 instance in us-west for the trial. Host: redwood-trial-usw1.medly.internal (sandbox).
4) Timeline & decision cadence
   - Week 0 (this week): legal review + minimal data access.
   - Week 1–2: model integration, sample evaluation, weekly syncs.
   - Week 3: internal scoring, exec readout (30–45m) for go/no-go.
   - Immediate next contract step upon go: procurement issues PO or move to Reserved (Dedicated).

Ask from you by EOD Tue: 1) confirm internal exec(s) who will attend the readout (name + role + availability windows 11/5–11/12), 2) confirm data delivery owner and sample cadence.

I've attached a lightweight config and a metrics template to help frame the evaluation. If we get the attendees and data owner this week, Karthik will map the eval rubric Monday and we can lock the readout window.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call summary & proposed trial playbook

Thanks Stephanie — that reads well and aligns with what our team needs. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Exec readout attendees: myself (VP Product), Hannah (Clinical Ops Director), and Dr. Miguel Santos (Head of Clinical Safety). We can make 11/10 AM PT or 11/12 PM PT work; prefer 11/10 if possible.
- Data owner: Hannah will own onboarding and will share a sample SFTP drop by 11/4.
- Procurement: I am the signatory for PO < $75k; anything above goes to procurement and will take ~2–3 weeks.

Two requests before we lock Week 1 work:
1) Can you confirm the expected token/hour usage estimate for the 7B q4 instance (rough calc for procurement)?
2) For the evaluation rubric, can you include a short human-review protocol we can run in parallel?

We'll review the config and the metrics template and get back with availability.

Tom
Tom Rivers
VP, Product — Medly Health
tom.r@medlyhealth.com | +1 212-555-0137

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: trial config & evaluation plan (draft)

Stephanie / Monica — drafting the internal runbook for the Medly pilot so we can push the MAP by EOD Thur. Key items I recommend we include (short):

- Runtime: Redwood-optimized-7B-q4 (KV cache enabled, dynamic batching up to 64 tokens), seq length typical = 512. Expected throughput: ~18k tokens/hr under baseline with continuous batching; burst capacity available for 1 hour/day. (This addresses Tom's procurement ask.)
- Token cost estimate (hosted equivalent): 0.0009 USD per 1k tokens on trial profile; projected 2-week token spend (integration + eval) ~= $1,300–1,800 depending on sampling.
- Eval harness: weekly automated scoring + manual spot-check (human review of 150 samples/week). Proposed human-review protocol attached.
- Acceptance gates: primary metric and quality gate as Stephanie listed; additional operational gate = <2% failed API calls under load.

I'll attach a cleaned 'redwood-trial-config-v1.yaml' and the human-review protocol for the MAP. Suggest we call out Dr. Miguel as safety reviewer for the exec slot.

[attachment: human-review-protocol.pdf (pdf)]

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Proposed readout agenda (30–45m)

- 10m: preliminary quality signals and demo (Karthik)
- 10m: risks, safety audit plan, and operational readiness (Dr. Miguel or Hannah)
- 5–10m: decision & next steps (Tom + procurement)

Readout availability: we propose the following slots (PT):
- Wed 11/10 10:00–10:45 (preferred)
- Fri 11/12 14:00–14:45

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-Medly-v1.pdf (MAP includes the DocuSign link and a shared Drive checklist). Please confirm the slot and I'll send the calendar invite with the MAP + pre-read.

Thanks —
Stephanie
